title: Prove: Dynamic array append is amortized O(1)
body:
A sequence of n appends to a geometrically growing array costs O(n) time in total.

Complexity: O(n) for n appends; O(1) amortized, O(n) worst case for a single resize.

title: Invariant: Dynamic array append is amortized O(1)
body: After every append, capacity is at least length; immediately after a resize, capacity is at most twice length.

title: Proof step: Base case
body: The first append writes one slot into the initial capacity and performs no copy.

title: Proof step: Resize points form a geometric series
body:
Capacity doubles only when length reaches capacity, so resizes happen at lengths 1, 2, 4, 8, and so on.

Depends on: base

title: Proof step: Total copy work is bounded
body:
Across all resizes the array copies at most 1 + 2 + 4 + ... + n slots, which is less than 2n.

Depends on: doubling

title: Proof step: Add writes and copies
body:
n appends perform n writes and fewer than 2n copies, so the sequence is linear and each append is O(1) on average.

Depends on: copies
